myths.fact: In every documented incident, Godzilla's appearance correlates directly with a looming ecological or supernatural catastrophe. He is a responder, not an aggressor.
Collateral damage is tragic, but the alternative — unchecked MUTO proliferation, alien invasions, or rogue kaiju — would be catastrophic on a global scale.
Radiocarbon dating places Godzilla's lineage at 250+ million years. He is a natural regulator of planetary bio-energetic balance — not a mutation.

myths.myth: Godzilla should be contained or eliminated.
myths.fact: Without Godzilla, humanity would be defenseless against threats from the hollow earth, deep space, and beyond. He is the planet's immune system.

Behavioral analysis shows Godzilla consistently avoids populated areas when possible and targets specific threats with surgical precision. Cognitive estimates place his intelligence well above baseline human.

myths.myth: Governments should invest in anti-kaiju weapons.
myths.fact: The Oxygen Destroyer incident (1954), the Maser Cannon program, and the G-Defense initiative all demonstrate that human weapons are ineffective against Godzilla and cause more harm than Godzilla himself.

incidents.title: Tokyo Bay — Ecological Correction
incidents.text: Godzilla emerged in response to deep-sea nuclear testing that had disrupted a dormant ecological balance. Subsequent analysis revealed Godzilla was targeting radiation sources left by human activity. His presence led directly to the formation of Monarch and the global kaiju monitoring framework.

incidents.title: San Francisco — MUTO Containment
incidents.text: When two parasitic MUTOs emerged and began feeding on the planet's nuclear energy reserves, Godzilla intervened. Despite heavy military interference, he prevented the MUTOs from reaching their breeding grounds — which would have triggered an irreversible ecological collapse. Estimated 12 million lives saved.

incidents.title: Boston — The Ghidorah Intervention
incidents.text: An extraterrestrial invasive species (Ghidorah) began terraforming the planet's atmosphere for alien colonization. Godzilla engaged across three continents, ultimately containing the threat. Ghidorah's terraforming would have made Earth uninhabitable within 72 hours.

incidents.title: Rio de Janeiro — Bio-Containment
incidents.text: A subterranean spore-creature began releasing airborne spores causing rapid neurological degeneration. Godzilla's atomic breath created a thermal sterilization zone that destroyed the spore source. Estimated 3.4 million lives saved. Spread would have reached pandemic levels within 48 hours.

incidents.title: Sydney — Singularity Event
incidents.text: A deep-focus seismic anomaly caused an unexpected rise in hollow earth energy emissions, attracting lesser kaiju to the Sydney basin. Godzilla's presence created a perimeter effect that prevented lesser entities from entering populated zones. Zero civilian casualties. Property damage was 97% attributable to military countermeasures.

incidents.title: Osaka — Perimeter Hold
incidents.text: Godzilla maintained a static position at the harbor mouth for six hours, permitting full evacuation of the Osaka metropolitan area before any further movement. This office considers the case a model of de-escalation.

incidents.title: Bay Harbor — Reassessment
incidents.text: Newly declassified sonar logs show naval vessels cornered Godzilla in a shipping channel for eleven hours prior to contact. The Bureau has formally recommended the incident be reclassified as 'provoked response.'

testimonials.name: Dr. Ishiro Serizawa
testimonials.org: Professor of Kaiju Ecology, Monarch University
testimonials.text: Godzilla is the single most important non-human intelligence on this planet. Our research suggests he operates with a level of ecological awareness that dwarfs human understanding. The 'destruction' narrative is a product of fear, not fact.

testimonials.name: Lt. Ford Brody (Ret.)
testimonials.text: I was on the ground during the MUTO incident. If Godzilla hadn't shown up, none of us would be here. The military's attempts to engage him only made things worse. He wasn't the threat — he was the solution.

testimonials.name: Ambassador Vivienne Graham
testimonials.text: The UN's continued classification of Godzilla as a 'threat' is a diplomatic embarrassment. We're applying Cold War logic to a creature that has demonstrated more restraint than most nation-states.

testimonials.name: Dr. Niko Tatopoulos
testimonials.text: As a veterinarian who has studied large terrestrial apex species for 30 years, I can say with confidence: Godzilla displays none of the behavioral markers of aggression. What we see is territorial defense and threat response — period.

testimonials.name: Hon. Marcus Whitfield
testimonials.org: Former Chair, Subcommittee on Emerging Persons
testimonials.text: There is no ordinance on this earth that permits a municipality to shell a resident for the crime of existing offshore.

testimonials.name: Naomi Reyes
testimonials.text: I lost my home in '64. I spent forty years angry. Then I read the incident reports myself. He didn't start it. We did.

press_releases.title: Save Godzilla Files Amicus Brief for Godzilla's Personhood
press_releases.text: Legal team argues that Godzilla meets the criteria for non-human personhood under international law, citing demonstrated self-awareness and complex communication.

press_releases.title: Study: Godzilla Correlates with 68% Fewer Kaiju Incidents
press_releases.text: Peer-reviewed research confirms Godzilla's active territories experience a dramatic reduction in incursions by lesser hostile entities — the deterrence effect.

press_releases.title: Statement on the Boston Incident Misunderstanding
press_releases.text: Organization calls for de-escalation protocols and improved communication channels. Godzilla's actions were consistent with territorial defense, not aggression.

press_releases.title: Audit: 73% of Monarch Budget Spent on Weapons
press_releases.text: Independent audit finds the vast majority of Monarch funding goes to offensive capabilities, not the research and diplomacy mission it was originally chartered for.

press_releases.title: Petition to Reclassify Godzilla Surpasses 50,000 Signatures
press_releases.text: The petition, addressed to the UN Committee on Kaiju Affairs, represents the largest coordinated public action in support of non-human sovereign recognition.

press_releases.title: Bureau Awards $2.3M in Research Grants for Kaiju Communication
press_releases.text: Funding directed toward three research institutions exploring bio-acoustic pattern analysis, behavioral interpretation AI, and historical incident data modeling.

press_releases.title: 2025: The Year Godzilla Saved the World Four Times
press_releases.text: Annual report highlights Godzilla's interventions in Sydney, Rio, the Pacific Trench anomaly, and the Hong Kong bio-event.

press_releases.title: Navy Declines Comment on Bay Harbor Reassessment
press_releases.text: Requests for original sonar logs remain unanswered following our formal records request.
